==Description:==
'''CAT-60''' is an entity that you may encounter in [[Super Epic Mode]], it works the same as [[A-60]] except he is a cat.

== Mechanic ==
Same as [[A-60]] but dissapears instantly instead of sinking into the floor.
==Stats:==

==Strategies==
When you hear '''CAT-60''', wait some seconds and when the screen starts getting staticy, hide.
